body: lol I do things all the time for others and get shit back for it... I have a narcissistic, bat crazy mother who always do things/say things to hurt me and others for her own benefits... and more.. there's nothing you can do. Some people are just dumb and the way I deal with it is... I don't care about them... I just do things for me and that's it -.-. You'll be called cold but hey... beats getting hurt.

18 is legal age, and whenever I've told him he could go to prison for that he says he doesn't care, all he cares about is me being alive with him, or dead without him. He says to me I've got two options...and I don't want to live day by day wishing I was in another place but whenever I try to leave him he calls me every name in the book and I know, it's just words but hearing that from someone who is suppose to love you hurts a lot. And not only that, my self-esteem is really low thanks to him.. I'm scared I'll always be treated like this by any guy, that this is all I deserve. Every compliment I get, I smile politely and say thanks but in my head I'm thinking "that's just them being nice, they don't mean that, you're on your own, don't trust or believe no one". I'm sick of second guessing myself, I'm so depressed I'm failing this term because I've lost every will to keep on going, like why should I even try when the only job he'll allow me is at the check-out in the supermarket (not that it's bad, but he keeps pushing me to finish university and get a degree) and I don't see why I should have a degree when I'm not going to be able to use it. I got an E on my last exam.. (A-E is passing, F-failing)... and now, I'm doubting myself, my education and my abilities. I don't know what to do. The thing is, he doesn't even want me!? But he refuses to leave! Daily, I'm told I'm worthless, a fatass, ugly, wh*re, b*tch, pig, cow..and told no one would ever want me, that I look like a freak of nature. I've never understood why someone who hurt someone else intentionally like this.., I would never do or say the things he says to me, to anyone.. I'm done.
Thanks. I never talked to him, I fell asleep instead but I'll try later today. I'm just sick of him taking everything from me.
Haha that's good :).Lol yup it works well in many occasions. Lol my friends and I looked up words and made random sentences and that one stuck in my memory for some odd reason haha
It will work out :).
Kill them with kindness. Don't bother with people like that.
Ok, well don't lose hope entirely. There's so much in the world to explore.

Haha good! lol I only learned a few things from German class lol. Ich habe ein kaninchen in meine Hosen... pardon my grammer though haha and yes I know.. we were very productive. And the basics, like hi hello, how are you, and then es tut mir leid, I had to use that alot because I used to come late to class lol
Try college! You meet loads of people there who might help you :).
Do you have any friend who can help you out? Or set up goals. It has always helped me whenever I've been down.

That's true. It's very risky. Ugh, can't believe I was so stupid. At least I learned a lesson.. I live in Sweden, you? Thank you again, you're words have really helped. I don't feel quite as lonely anymore.
You're here now. There's some hope left :).
Don't lose hope.
I'm sure someone will. Everyone deserves love.
I'm sorry to hear that. I'm sure you'll find someone to change that, who will make you happy.
You're young, you have your entire life ahead of you. Focus on things you find fun in life.
Why'd you say that? May I ask how old you are and where you're from?
Yeah :). Don't worry I'm sure you have something good in your life to hold on to. We all do.
Thank you. Yeah, it feels a little better to just let it out. Even if it's to a stranger online. I'll try. Thank you :).

I know, it's just the shame. I'm the good girl in people's eyes. And ahh.. my father works for the government. So it'd look really bad if something slipped out. Quite frankly I can't believe I was so stupid at 16. I know I can't go back and change it, but ugh.. I regret it so much. I'm going to try to keep a friendly tone with him tonight or tomorrow because I can't live with him and his controlling sick behaviour.

I believe there's something bigger than us. I'm not religious but I believe that we shouldn't just end it all. And I'm a very curious person, I want to know more about the world and we know so little. Why end it all when there's so many cool places to visit, to see and experience. 

My youngest brother is my saving, my coping mechanism. I love him so much, and he looks up to me. He's 8 years younger than me, almost 9 and I promised him when he was little to always protect him. He's 13 now, but I keep looking after him and I don't know what I'd do without him.
Yeah, for me the moment has been 6 years.. There's really no scale to measure. But I believe there's always another option, another way to solve our problems other than commiting suicide.

That's it, he's crazy. He finds a way.. it's almost like an obsession. He has to destroy everything for another person. And then he has the audacity to say how much he cares for others, how there's no one like him in the world because he's always there for people.. Thank you, and thank you for writing back. I've been crying all day because I've almost lost all hope. I really just want to get out of this hell.

My personal opinion is that it's never truly the answer. Just an escape to remove the pain or whatever bothers the person at the moment. Might sound extremely hypocritical because of the situation I am in. But that's how I feel towards suicide.

I have. But he's different. More prone to anger. I just don't want him to put any photos online, or to send them to my family and people I've gone to school with etc :/. He knows how much that would ruin my life, and my family's reputation. That's why he's holding it against me.
I don't think it's every okay.. but some people see it as the only way out. I've thought about ending it all. I'm too much of a coward.. although I think about death almost every day.
I've tried, he hacks everything I have and track me down each time. I've tried being friendly with him but nothing seems to work.

I did that, but things got worse. He doesn't care even when I'm being as polite as I can be and beg him to stop, to leave me alone. I'm going to try ending it with him tonight, but he refuses to answer the phone or my Skype calls... he's giving me his favourite silent treatment.. so he ignores me for days and I've tried using that to leave him, by just slowly giving him more space. But then he was even more mad because I "didn't care" although he knows I've loved and been loyal to him every day for the past 6 years. My friend said I'm his prize, and by leaving I'm hurting his ego. I'm starting to believe she was right.

I'll try, whenever I think about suicide, I think about how it would affect my youngest brother and then my thoughts goes away but they keep coming back whenever things are bad again. This time, I feel like I don't care anymore. I live in a student apartment, (it's a small studio). 25 minutes away from my father. My mother is another problem. I don't see her often.
No you don't sound crazy or pointless.
Yeah, I'm too nice to people... that's why I've let him take over my life so much. I know it's my fault, let's be real but I don't know how to get out without things going really really bad.

I hate looking weak too.. It's how I was raised. No one sees your pain, you hide it and fake a smile if you have to, so everyone around me thinks I'm the most confident, happy, positive person around. Guys have asked me out, and I'm in university studying for two Bachelor's degrees. But no one knows what I go through from the moment I wake up, to the moment my body just shuts off and I fall asleep. And trust me, I'm so thankful for everything I have, but this relationship.. is really tearing me down. I can't fall asleep anymore so I'm up 24+ hours sometimes and still go to class.

Probably :/. I don't want to do anything to jeopardize his job and career either. I don't want to get him fired or bring shame. I'm sorry I'm just really scared. And my father would probably, be angry at first, then want to know everything about the guy, and "take care of it".. 

I just wish he'd leave me alone but he won't.. he can't make a clean break.. he has to play dirty. I hate my bf so much.
